details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent with no material contradictions or logical gaps. All statements are consistent with each other: the summary consistently describes declining revenues and net losses across periods, with regional performance variations that logically contribute to the overall trends. The financial metrics (turnover, losses, expenses, cash flow) are presented without internal contradictions. The organization flows logically from revenue performance to profitability, expense breakdown, liquidity, and balance sheet changes. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all relationships between figures (e.g., regional contributions to total revenue) are logically consistent within the summary itself. No arithmetic contradictions are present because the summary does not claim that regional figures are exhaustive additive components of the same total.
